mandatory_conditions: 1. Decision-support only: The detector assists human reviewers; automated academic accusations or disciplinary rejections are strictly prohibited.
2. Single-node institutional deployment: Maximum 2 concurrent active scans; SQLite DB size <= 10GB (Governance Recommendation); reference corpus <= 50,000 items.
3. Strict air-gapped zero-network isolation on local LAN or standalone workstation with zero external WAN connectivity.
4. Post-pilot calibration: The pilot must be used to collect and expert-review >= 100 real anonymized samples via reviewer_tool.py before wider deployment.
